description_short.value: Accra-based advertising, events and printing company, listed on the Ghana Alternative Market; part of Groupe Nduom.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Digicut Production & Advertising PLC audited financial statements for 2025 (GSE PR 138/2026, report of the directors) and 2024 (shareholding note)

description_full.value: Digicut Production & Advertising PLC provides advertising, marketing and public relations services, plans and manages events, and does printing work, including PVC ID cards, digital imaging on SAV and flex, and general printing. It operates from Avenor in Accra. The company was incorporated in December 2017 and listed on the Ghana Alternative Market in April 2018, after an IPO at 8 pesewas a share that raised about GHS 2.85 million. Groupe Nduom owns 70% of its shares and Ghana Growth Fund about 17%. It is small: revenue was GHS 0.82 million in 2025, and it has reported a loss in every year from 2020 to 2025. With retained earnings in deficit, the directors recommended no dividend for 2024 or 2025.
